title: Appendix A — Proposal
text:
Title: GDP impacted by Social media?!
Team: Hazel, Lionel
Description: this project mainly focuses on discovering the relationship between Social media and GDP growth, researching on whether the categories of social media post’s topics also reveal people’s perceptions about the economy.
Research question: Is there a relationship between GDP growth and the proportion of political posts on social media platforms (Instagram and Twitter) across U.S. states? Do the topics of social media posts reflect people’s perceptions of economic conditions? How does the relationship between political social media activity and GDP growth vary across states?
The reasons/inspirations behind choosing the topic: Social media is becoming an essential part of modern city life and a significant contributor to economic growth. We hope to take a closer look at the relationship between economy and media growth; it can also be interesting to visualise media usage together with other GDP contributors so as to better understand the role social media plays in a country’s economy.
one potential data set that can be used to answer the research questions URL: https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=doi:10.7910/DVN/T39JBY Human Flourishing Geographic Index
